Summary:

Luxury 4-bedroom villa in the heart of Rosemary Beach. Enjoy European-inspired design, a sunny private courtyard & pool, and inviting indoor-outdoor living.

Open-concept living area perfect for family gatherings

Fully equipped chef’s kitchen & outdoor dining space

Smart TVs & high-speed Wi-Fi throughout

Seconds from boutiques, cafés & bike paths of 30A

Book now and make lasting memories by your own private pool!



The Space:

Luxury European-style retreat in the heart of Rosemary Beach. Relax in your private pool & overflow spa, unwind in the lush courtyard, and stroll to dining, shops, and sugar-white sand.

4 spacious bedrooms, sleeps 10

High-speed WiFi & smart TVs

Chef's kitchen & grill for family feasts

Washer/dryer & parking on site

Perfect for families or friends seeking space, style, and sunshine-book your getaway today!



Guest Access:

Access to the entire home as well as the private pool and carriage house.



Interaction with Guests:

I am dedicated to ensuring you have a seamless and enjoyable stay at the Luxury Rosemary Villa. I'm available to assist you throughout your visit and can be reached via the platform messaging system or by phone. I typically respond to inquiries within an hour. For urgent matters, please don't hesitate to reach out. I'm happy to provide recommendations, answer questions, or address any concerns you may have to make your vacation unforgettable.
Our prices include all fees. No hidden fees.

reviews.author: Lisa W.
reviews.label: Good

responses.response: Thank you so much for your review, Chole! We're so happy to hear you enjoyed your stay and that the home, pool, hot tub, and guest house all made for a great experience. We truly appreciate you mentioning the issue with the maintenance visits — we're so sorry for the lack of communication on our part. We completely understand how important it is to have privacy and clear notice, and we'll be taking steps to ensure future guests are informed ahead of time if any service visits are necessary during their stay. Thank you again for staying with us, and we hope to have the chance to welcome you back for an even smoother visit in the future!

reviews.text: Was an amazing place to stay, large house with pool, hot tub and a guest house. Only complaint is that the property manager sent over maintenance people (pool cleaner, someone to fix appliances) without contacting in advance to let us know.

reviews.text: We enjoyed our stay here. The kitchen is spacious and works well for a large group. Our teenagers enjoyed the private apartment over the garage. The pool and hot tub are great amenities. However, we had trouble with the hot tub control. We had a great time at this location.

reviews.label: Excellent
reviews.text: Our family all came together for vacation. It was the first time the cousins had all been together. They loved the pool! Whenever i had a question the management was quick to respond and solve our problem. We’ve stayed all over Rosemary Beach in our last 20 years of vacationing there but I think we’ve found our favorite spot!

reviews.author: Tyler C.
reviews.label: Excellent
reviews.text: We do a yearly memorial weekend trip to Rosemary Beach. This was the first time we were able to secure a place with a private pool. We had a great time at our stay and loved the location. My only critique would be the communication upon check in. It wasn’t clear at first how to work the spa and pool heater or where the RFID cards were located for the beach and the pools. Otherwise, we had an amazing trip and will try to book this place again in the future.
